slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: 很快，一个身材壮硕，面容憨厚的青年被带进了大殿。
“江晨拜见家主，各位族老！”江晨有些惶恐，他正在修炼突然被带到这，还有点懵。
江战没有废话，直接将升灵丹交给他，沉声道：
“江晨，这是帝子赐予你的无上造化，服下他。”
江晨虽然不明白是什么，但出于对家主的绝对信任，
他没有丝毫犹豫，接过丹药，一口吞了下去。
升灵丹入腹的瞬间，江晨的身体猛地一震。
一股无法形容的恐怖能量在他体内轰然炸开，
仿佛开天辟地一般，瞬间冲刷着他的四肢百骸！
江晨发出一声痛苦的嘶吼，他的皮肤开始寸寸龟裂，
金色的血液从裂缝中渗透出来，整个人仿佛变成了一个即将破碎的瓷器。
但紧接着，一股磅礴的生机又从他体内涌出，快速修复着他破碎的身体。
轰隆！
一道璀璨的金色神光从江晨天灵盖冲天而起，直接洞穿了议事大殿的穹顶，贯穿云霄！
江战双眸爆发出炽热的精光，随手一抬，漫天异象被尽数遮掩。
“这，这是……永恒星魂神体！”
一位对各种体质钻研极深的族老，声音发颤地惊呼道，“陨星战体的进化路线之一！”
“没错，绝对是永恒星魂神体！江晨的神魂与太古星河的本命星辰绑定，
肉身若死也可盘踞于太古星辰上复苏！我族历史的的江无道老祖就曾经掌握过这种神体！”
“一枚丹药，造就一尊神体！这太可怕了！”
“不对！你们没听江渊说吗？这升灵丹可以提升圣体之下，也就是说，如果一开始就找神体的族子，我们江家将会多出一位圣体！”
所有族老都忍不住倒吸一口冷气。
圣体啊，号称大成可叫板大帝。
虽然并非所有圣体都能做到这一步，更多还是需要自身积累。
但一尊圣体约等于一位大成巅峰准帝强者那是一点都不夸张！
就算放眼江家，
巅峰准帝也绝对是重量级！
大约一炷香后，江晨身上的金光渐渐收敛，蜕变完成，境界在极短时间内从7境【归一境】飞跃到9境【法则境】巅峰！
“我……我这是……”江晨感受着体内的变化，一脸吃惊。
“江晨！”
江战沉声喝道，“从今日起，你便是我江家核心弟子，家族将倾尽资源培养你，你只需记住，你的一切，都是帝子所赐。”
“是！江晨……谢帝子再造之恩！”
江晨回过神来，毫不犹豫地对着江渊跪下，重重地磕了三个响头，眼神里充满了狂热的崇拜和感激。
“今日之事暂时不得泄露，你先退下吧，我等与帝子还有话说。”
“是！”江晨朝着江渊等人一礼，无比恭敬的告辞离去。
待江晨离开后，三长老立刻上前冲到江战面前，激动地说道。
“渊儿，你的这天生生育圣体，简直是我江家万古未有之祥瑞！”
“方才你说要找到评分90分以上的天之骄女？”
江渊状若含蓄的点点头：“是，是系统这么要求的啦。”
content_en:
Soon, a young man with a strong build and a simple face was brought into the hall.
"Jiang Chen pays homage to the Patriarch, clan elders!" Jiang Chen was a little frightened. He was suddenly brought here while he was practicing, and he was still a little confused.
Jiang Zhan didn't waste any time and directly handed him the Spirit-raising Pill and said in a deep voice:
"Jiang Chen, this is the supreme creation bestowed upon you by the Emperor. Accept him."
Although Jiang Chen didn't understand what it was, out of his absolute trust in the family leader,
Without any hesitation, he took the pill and swallowed it in one gulp.
The moment the Shengling Pill entered his stomach, Jiang Chen's body shook violently.
An indescribable terrifying energy exploded in his body,
It was like the creation of the world, washing over his limbs and bones in an instant!
"Ah——!"
Jiang Chen let out a painful roar, and his skin began to crack inch by inch.
Golden blood seeped out from the cracks, and the whole person seemed to have turned into a piece of porcelain that was about to break.
But then, a majestic vitality surged out of his body, quickly repairing his broken body.
Boom!
A bright golden divine light soared into the sky from Jiang Chen's Tianling Cap, directly piercing the dome of the meeting hall and penetrating the sky!
Jiang Zhan's eyes burst out with blazing light, and he raised his hand, and all the visions in the sky were covered up.
"This, this is... the Eternal Star Soul Divine Body!"
A clan elder who had a deep understanding of various physiques exclaimed with a trembling voice, "One of the evolutionary routes for meteorite combat bodies!"
"Yes, it is definitely the eternal star soul divine body! Jiang Chen's divine soul is bound to the natal star of the ancient galaxy.
Even if the physical body dies, it can still be resurrected on the ancient stars! The ancestor Jiang Wudao in the history of our clan once mastered this divine body! "
"One elixir creates a divine body! This is too terrifying!"
"No! Didn't you listen to what Jiang Yuan said? This spiritual elixir can be used to improve the Holy Body. In other words, if we find a descendant of the Divine Body from the beginning, our Jiang family will have one more Holy Body!"
"Hiss——"
All the clan elders couldn't help but gasp.
Holy body, it is said that Dacheng can be called the Great Emperor.
Although not all holy bodies can achieve this step, more still need to accumulate by themselves.
But it is not an exaggeration at all that a holy body is approximately equal to a powerful quasi-emperor at the peak of Dacheng!
Even if we look at the Jiang family,
The peak quasi-emperor is definitely a heavyweight!
After about a stick of incense, the golden light on Jiang Chen's body gradually converged, and his transformation was completed. In a very short period of time, his realm leapt from the 7th realm [Reunion Realm] to the 9th realm [Law Realm] peak!
"I...I am..." Jiang Chen felt the changes in his body and looked surprised.
"Jiang Chen!"
Jiang Zhan shouted in a deep voice, "From today on, you are the core disciple of my Jiang family. The family will devote all its resources to cultivating you. You only need to remember that everything you have is given by the emperor."
"Yes! Jiang Chen... thanks the emperor for his kindness!"
Jiang Chen came back to his senses, knelt down to Jiang Yuan without hesitation, and kowtowed three times, his eyes filled with fanatical admiration and gratitude.
"Today's events must not be leaked for the time being. Please step back first. We still have something to say with the Emperor."
"Yes!" Jiang Chen saluted Jiang Yuan and others, then left with great respect.
After Jiang Chen left, the third elder immediately rushed forward to Jiang Zhan and said excitedly.
"Yuan'er, your Holy Body of Innate Fertility is simply the most auspicious thing our Jiang family has ever seen!"
"Just now you said you wanted to find a proud woman with a score of 90 or above?"
Jiang Yuan Zhuangruo nodded implicitly: "Yes, the system requires it."
